main_text.p: fectus anni lunaris Arabici à solaris est 10. dier. 21. hor. 1. m. Defectus ille unius-cujusqve anni in annis 993. integris con-surgit in summam diem 10799, h. 13. m. 33. Anni vero 29. solares dies conficiunt 10592. min. 41. horas, & minuta ista se-curi nunc negligimus. Dies igitur 10592, tolle ex 10799, sive annos 29. à 993, residui erunt anni Christiani 964, & dies 207. rursus eximendi, nam omnes dies defectus lunaris sunt exemptiles. De-nuo itaque ab annis Christianis 964, tol-le dies 237, annos assequeris 963, dies 158. Dico igitur annos Hegirae 993. comple-tos æqvari annis solaribus 963, diebus 158. Hinc facile est, postremum diem Anni Arabici 993[?]. oruere[?], & Neomeniam Muharram anni Arabici 994. Annus so-laris Hegirae semper finitur 15. Julii, & incipit 16. ejusdem mensis, à quo die si numeres 158. dies, terminabitur annus il-le 20. page.notes: Doubtful readings: "dieum" (line 3) is as printed, possibly for "diem"; "993" in "Anni Arabici 993." is damaged and the digit is uncertain; "oruere" may be "eruere". The leading word "fectus" is a fragment from the previous page. Old-style numerals are copied as printed. No Greek or Hebrew on this page.
